correctness.rationale: Over characteristic not two write X=aI+U, Y=bI+V with U,V traceless. Cayley–Hamilton makes the traceless part of the square sum 2(aU+bV); if a or b is nonzero, U,V are dependent and commute. Thus the noncommuting case is traceless. For Q(u,v,w)=u²+vw and any d, counting vw=d−u² gives n(d)=q²+qχ(d), including n(0)=q². An independent check of the pair convolution starts with the unrestricted level Q(U)+Q(V)=c: the two product variables form a dot product against a coefficient pair. If that pair is nonzero it contributes q³(q²−1); if zero it contributes q² times the two-square count q−χ(−1) at c≠0 and q+(q−1)χ(−1) at c=0. Remove 2q²n(c), adding back q⁴ only when c=0. For commuting invertible traceless pairs the nonscalar first factor has centralizer span(I,U), so V=tU with t≠0. At zero the commuting count is (1+χ(−1))(q−1)q². Otherwise sum n(c/(1+t²)) over t≠0 with 1+t²≠0; the character sum on nonzero t equals −2, by (z−t)(z+t)=1. Subtraction yields both frozen formulas. The square/nonsquare difference is 4q(q²−1); relative to the larger nonsquare level, the zero level exceeds it by q(q²−1)(q−2). The smallest nonzero-target lower bound is positive at q=3 and increases thereafter.
residual_risks: Fresh replay: generate matrices by four entries, filter nonzero determinant, cache literal matrix squares and test scalar sum and unequal products for all ordered pairs. Exhaustive in GL₂ at q=3 and 5, giving central target fibers by c of (144,24,120) and (2400,1560,2040,2040,1560). At q=9, restricting to trace zero using the proved lemma and working modulo t²+1 over F₃ gives levels 51840, 43920, 46800 with frequencies 1,4,4. These are bounded corroboration, not a general proof.

value.rationale: Central outputs are a natural singular locus of the square-sum map where noncommutation enforces a sharp reduction. The exact census shows all scalar values survive both invertibility and noncommutation, even over F₃, and identifies a residual square-class bias invisible in existence or unrestricted matrix counts. This is a meaningful restricted word-fiber invariant for all odd prime-power fields.
residual_risks: The conclusion is specific to two-by-two scalar targets and does not measure general nonscalar matrix-square representability.
